currentScopeReview.formDecision: Omit accompaniment-only m1–7. Retain all of m8–23. D5 at excerpt beat 30 lasts 2 beats to the boundary at 32. Stop before the fresh m24 pickup; later written-out returns, contrasting material and the full ending through m89 are outside this selection.
currentScopeReview.independentReview: All 61 final tuples, seven ties, five melody rests, meter, tempo and boundary agree after independent source-pixel review. The first independent m22 reading was G5; reinspection of the first ledger line above F5 resolved it to A5. Initial readings were not identical.
currentScopeReview.tempoDecision: Preserve printed quarter=96 and actual 2/4. The editorial defaultSpeedFactor 0.4 is a deliberate slow-practice button suggestion, not a printed marking or a change to current/remembered speed. The runtime first-visit 0.55 selection is separate.
currentScopeReview.difficultyDecision: Medium is an editorial conditional slow-practice rating, not a source marking or a claim that the source tempo is easy. Seven ties remove retriggers; fewer attacks alone do not establish easier playing.

practiceSignals.interpretation: Encoded timing and app-layout signals only; no fingering or physical-comfort guarantee.

currentScopeReview.versionDecision: Select this alternate EOP first-theme edition; this is not proof that the old edition is wrong. The unavailable Qupu source is not recovered or reverified. After unfolding seven EOP ties, all 68 pitch heads agree in sequence with the old version; six notehead timing tuples at EOP m18/m20 differ after a comparison-only halving of old beat values.
currentScopeReview.timebaseDecision: The EOP 32 quarter beats and historical 64 encoded beats use different notation/timebases. This does not mean that half of the familiar thematic outline was removed. Do not halve the new tempo or splice in the historical rhythm.
